The '''New Heurkea system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It lay between the [[Mantan system/Legends|Mantan]] and [[Sanctuary system]]s on the [[Prously's Rim Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The system shared its name with [[Heurkea Floating City|Heurkea]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|38|Heurkea}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The New Heurkea system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square U-6.<ref name="Atlas" />
